items.source: If you have classes which need binding (mostly needed when serializing or deserializing JSON), you can use @RegisterReflectionForBinding on any bean. Most of the hints are automatically inferred, for example when accepting or returning data from a @RestController method. But when you work with WebClient, RestClient or RestTemplate directly, you might need to use @RegisterReflectionForBinding.
items.translation: 如果您有需要绑定（主要在序列化或反序列化 JSON 时需要）的类，可以在任何 bean 上使用 @RegisterReflectionForBinding。 大多数提示会自动推断，例如在从 @RestController 方法接收或返回数据时。 但是，当您直接使用 WebClient、RestClient 或 RestTemplate 时，可能需要使用 @RegisterReflectionForBinding。

Without the @NestedConfigurationProperty annotation on the nested field, the my.properties.nested.number property would not be bindable in a native image. You can also annotate the getter method.

items.source: You can then use @ImportRuntimeHints on any @Configuration class (for example your @SpringBootApplication annotated application class) to activate those hints.
items.translation: 然后，您可以在任何@Configuration类（例如您的带有@SpringBootApplication注解的应用程序类）上使用@ImportRuntimeHints来激活这些提示。

items.source: The RuntimeHintsPredicates API can be used to test your hints. The API provides methods that build a Predicate that can be used to test a RuntimeHints instance.
items.translation: RuntimeHintsPredicates` API 可用于测试您的提示。该 API 提供用于构建 Predicate` 的方法，该对象可用于测试 RuntimeHints` 实例。

items.source: If you prefer, custom hints can be provided statically in one or more GraalVM JSON hint files. Such files should be placed in src/main/resources/ within a META-INF/native-image/*/*/ directory. The hints generated during AOT processing are written to a directory named META-INF/native-image/{groupId}/{artifactId}/. Place your static hint files in a directory that does not clash with this location, such as META-INF/native-image/{groupId}/{artifactId}-additional-hints/.
items.translation: 如果您偏好，可以静态地在 GraalVM JSON 提示文件中提供一个或多个自定义提示。这些文件应放置在 src/main/resources/` 下的 `META-INF/native-image/*/*/` 目录中。AOT 处理期间生成的提示会写入名为 `META-INF/native-image/{groupId}/{artifactId}/` 的目录。请将您的静态提示文件放置在不与该位置冲突的目录中，例如 `META-INF/native-image/{groupId}/{artifactId}-additional-hints/。

items.source: Spring Boot applications usually use Cloud Native Buildpacks through the Maven (mvn spring-boot:build-image) or Gradle (gradle bootBuildImage) integrations. You can, however, also use pack to turn an AOT processed Spring Boot executable jar into a native container image.
items.translation: Spring Boot 应用程序通常通过 Maven（`mvn spring-boot:build-image`）或 Gradle（`gradle bootBuildImage`）集成来使用 Cloud Native Buildpacks。不过，您也可以使用 pack 将 AOT 处理的 Spring Boot 可执行 jar 转换为原生容器镜像。

items.source: Reflection hints are automatically created for configuration properties by the Spring ahead-of-time engine. Nested configuration properties which are not inner classes, however, must be annotated with @NestedConfigurationProperty, otherwise they won’t be detected and will not be bindable.
items.translation: Spring 提前编译引擎会自动为配置属性创建反射提示。然而，如果不是内部类的嵌套配置属性，必须使用 @NestedConfigurationProperty 进行注解，否则它们将无法被检测到且不可绑定。

items.source: As native-image does not support cross-compilation, you can keep an OS neutral deployment artifact which you convert later to different OS architectures.
items.translation: 由于`native-image不支持交叉编译，您可以保留一个与操作系统无关的部署工件，稍后将其转换为不同的操作系统架构。

items.source: First, make sure that a Docker daemon is available (see Get Docker for more details). Configure it to allow non-root user if you are on Linux.
items.translation: 首先，确保已安装 Docker 守护进程（有关更多详细信息，请参阅 获取 Docker）。如果您使用的是 Linux，请配置它以允许非 root 用户。

items.source: You also need to install pack by following the installation guide on buildpacks.io.

items.translation: 一旦 pack` 完成，您可以使用 `docker run 启动应用程序：

items.source: Another option to turn an AOT processed Spring Boot executable jar into a native executable is to use the GraalVM native-image tool. For this to work, you’ll need a GraalVM distribution on your machine. You can either download it manually on the Liberica Native Image Kit page or you can use a download manager like SDKMAN!.
items.translation: 另一种将 AOT 处理的 Spring Boot 可执行 jar 转换为原生可执行文件的方法是使用 GraalVM native-image 工具。 要使此方法生效，您需要在机器上安装 GraalVM 发行版。 您可以手动从 Liberica Native Image Kit 页面 下载，或者使用 SDKMAN! 等下载管理器。

items.source: If you encounter problems when generating native images for Spring Boot applications, please check the Spring Boot with GraalVM page of the Spring Boot wiki. You can also contribute issues to the spring-aot-smoke-tests project on GitHub which is used to confirm that common application types are working as expected.
items.translation: 如果在为 Spring Boot 应用程序生成原生镜像时遇到问题，请检查 Spring Boot wiki 中的Spring Boot with GraalVM页面。 您还可以向 GitHub 上的spring-aot-smoke-tests项目提交问题，该项目用于确认常见的应用程序类型是否按预期工作。

items.source: It is possible to convert a Spring Boot executable jar into a native image as long as the jar contains the AOT generated assets. This can be useful for a number of reasons, including:
items.translation: 可以将包含 AOT 生成资产的 Spring Boot 可执行 jar 转换为原生镜像。这可用于多种原因，包括：

items.source: You can convert a Spring Boot executable jar into a native image using Cloud Native Buildpacks, or using the native-image tool that is shipped with GraalVM.
items.translation: 您可以使用 Cloud Native Buildpacks 将 Spring Boot 可执行 jar 转换为原生镜像，或使用随 GraalVM 一起提供的 native-image 工具。

items.source: The GraalVM native image tracing agent allows you to intercept reflection, resources or proxy usage on the JVM in order to generate the related hints. Spring should generate most of these hints automatically, but the tracing agent can be used to quickly identify the missing entries.
items.translation: GraalVM 原生镜像追踪代理允许您在 JVM 上拦截反射、资源或代理的使用，以生成相关的提示。Spring 应能自动生成这些提示的大部分，但可以使用追踪代理快速识别缺失的条目。

items.source: Now you can exercise the code paths you want to have hints for and then stop the application with ctrl-c.
items.translation: 现在您可以运行需要提示的代码路径，然后使用 ctrl-c 停止应用程序。

items.source: On application shutdown the native image tracing agent will write the hint files to the given config output directory. You can either manually inspect these files, or use them as input to the native image build process. To use them as input, copy them into the src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/ directory. The next time you build the native image, GraalVM will take these files into consideration.
items.translation: 应用程序关闭时，原生镜像跟踪代理会将提示文件写入指定的配置输出目录。您可以手动检查这些文件，或将它们用作原生镜像构建过程的输入。若要将其用作输入，请将其复制到 src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/ 目录中。下次构建原生镜像时，GraalVM 将考虑这些文件。

items.source: There are more advanced options which can be set on the native image tracing agent, for example filtering the recorded hints by caller classes, etc. For further reading, please see the official documentation.
items.translation: 原生镜像跟踪代理支持更多高级选项，例如通过调用方类过滤记录的提示等。有关更多信息，请参阅官方文档。

items.source: GraalVM native images are an evolving technology and not all libraries provide support. The GraalVM community is helping by providing reachability metadata for projects that don’t yet ship their own. Spring itself doesn’t contain hints for 3rd party libraries and instead relies on the reachability metadata project.
items.translation: GraalVM 原生镜像是一项不断发展的技术，并非所有库都提供支持。GraalVM 社区通过为尚未发布自身可达性元数据的项目提供可达性元数据来提供帮助。Spring 本身不包含针对第三方库的提示，而是依赖可达性元数据项目。

items.source: If you find a library which doesn’t work with GraalVM, please raise an issue on the reachability metadata project.
items.translation: 如果您发现某个库无法与 GraalVM 配合使用，请在可达性元数据项目上提交问题。

items.source: You can keep your regular JVM pipeline and turn the JVM application into a native image on your CI/CD platform.
items.translation: 您可以保留常规的 JVM 流水线，并在您的 CI/CD 平台上将 JVM 应用程序转换为原生镜像。

items.source: When using the agent to generate hints for a native image, there are a couple of approaches:
items.translation: 在使用代理为原生镜像生成提示时，有几种方法：

items.source: Launch the application directly and exercise it.
items.translation: 直接启动应用程序并对其进行测试。

items.source: Run application tests to exercise the application.
items.translation: 运行应用程序测试以执行应用程序。

items.source: The first option is interesting for identifying the missing hints when a library or a pattern is not recognized by Spring.
items.translation: 第一个选项在 Spring 未识别某个库或模式时，有助于识别缺失的提示。

items.source:
The second option sounds more appealing for a repeatable setup, but by default the generated hints will include anything required by the test infrastructure.
Some of these will be unnecessary when the application runs for real.
To address this problem the agent supports an access-filter file that will cause certain data to be excluded from the generated output.
items.translation: 第二种方案对于可重复的设置来说听起来更具吸引力，但默认情况下，生成的提示将包含测试基础设施所需的所有内容。其中一些在应用程序实际运行时将是多余的。为了解决这个问题，代理支持一个访问过滤文件，该文件会导致某些数据被排除在生成的输出之外。
